scope: Nuevo dibujo desde el PDF. Las transcripciones y la paginación del pasaje coinciden con la edición previa.

pages.summary: Draco recibe a Robin mientras Astoria acompaña a Scorpius. Los primos juegan a salpicar y descubren que también pueden mojarse a sí mismos.

panels.scene: On the very low pale shoreline rock, Pansy on left passes Robin, deep chestnut curls and blue yellow-duck shorts, securely into hands of seated Draco center. Both adults guide him until he is held against Draco. Astoria right sits safely adjacent and keeps pale platinum Scorpius in gray trunks seated on her lap. Exactly two clearly distinct babies and three adults. Pansy bare fingers, delicate chain only on anatomical LEFT wrist. No lettering.

Draco and Astoria seated beside one another on the same flat rock at shallow water. Draco supports the chestnut boy Robin at belly; Robin leans just far enough to pat calm water with two small natural hands. Astoria supports Scorpius upright on her lap; he watches his curly-haired cousin. Faces above water.

Scorpius now tries a light pat himself. Astoria's arm circles his belly, one small hand splashes just a few droplets. Robin laughs, kicks and leans forward to imitate him while Draco keeps his right hand securely at Robin's waist. Side directions and separate anatomies clear, neither child tips far.

Draco on left brings Robin gently back to sit upright between his knees, one arm at waist. Astoria next to him still holds Scorpius. Only Draco speaks close to Robin, one clear head-level balloon. Keep green and gray-blue eye colors distinct.

Robin gleefully taps water and small splash hits Draco's chest. Draco supports him with one clearly seen forearm, mouth smiling up and one head-level balloon pointing to Draco. Astoria with Scorpius secondary on right if room.
dialogue: Draco: Ya vi que quieres continuar.

panels.scene: Astoria in a tighter composition supports Scorpius from behind at waist with one arm and gently guides his two little hands toward surface; he reaches forward as his stronger small splash has reached his own cheeks. Stable seated position with her knees around him, gray opaque shorts. Natural scattered droplets.

Scorpius on Astoria's lap shuts eyes in surprise at his own splash. Astoria wipes just one cheek gently with her fingertips. Robin still at left on Draco's lap laughs. Draco on left looks down to Robin and speaks BOTH sentences; one prominent balloon with a tail aligned to the platinum adult only. Foreground figures distinct.
dialogue: Draco: No te rías de tu primo. Tú hiciste lo mismo.

panels.scene: Wide low sunny rocky shoreline. Astoria sets her dark scarfed head on Draco's right shoulder. His right arm comfortably circles her waist; his left hand is visibly joined to left arm as he steadies Robin at the belly. Astoria supports Scorpius safely with both her arms. The cousins giggle and kick separately, feet close to surface. One narrow wooden navy yacht in back with only its single gangway and tightly furled ivory sails. No words.

pages.summary: Pansy persigue a Hermione entre las rocas. La carrera termina con cosquillas, risas y una salpicadura que deja a ambas a mano.

panels.scene: Wide airy establishing shot. Hermione the olive-suited woman in a chestnut wet curly bun swims in front toward a soft low pale rock, her own foreground left arm extends for a normal swimming stroke. Pansy in her black suit follows several meters behind, compact dark chin bob and black sunglasses. Single distant furled ketch with one gangway behind. No other figures.

Chest-up three-quarter profile of Hermione left in olive as she looks back and notices Pansy gaining on her, laughing mouth just opening to warn. Pansy has black chin bob and a mischievous smile and is still behind in the back-right. The short bubble points to Hermione's head.

Wide side shot. Hermione curves around the low rock with a strong kick, her own sensible momentum following the curve. Pansy has nearly caught her, reaches only ONE hand and just brushes the outer side of Hermione's olive suit. The water and body angle separate both arm silhouettes. Pansy's far arm submerged and Hermione's lead arm clearly extends in her motion. No words.

Both come into adjacent water-level view with Hermione to the left and Pansy to the right, Hermione trying to swim off through the left edge. Two complete speech balloons. First higher-left pointing to Hermione; second lower-right to Pansy. These are the two distinct grown women with consistent recognizable hair and profiles.

At the next rock, from a slightly wider side angle. Hermione laughs and pushes her own LEFT open hand off the smooth rock, wrist and forearm meeting clearly up to her shoulder. Pansy approaches from behind and gently tickles just at Hermione's side with one set of normal fingers, her other arm around her side for balance. Casual non-suggestive framing at water level; the water covers both lower bodies. Keep sapphire only at Hermione neck and one left ring finger ring as seen. Each arm connects to correct body.

Most important hand anatomy panel. Both have just resurfaced after a short harmless dip, laughing face-to-face with sufficient physical space. Hermione left and Pansy right. At middle-low level Hermione steadies Pansy with her LEFT hand placed on the outside of Pansy's upper arm; use an unbroken, unobscured visible connection from Hermione's own shoulder through bent elbow and wrist to that one hand, fingers wrapping gently around the arm. Hermione's clear halo ring only at left ring finger, bare wrist. At a distinctly HIGHER level Pansy extends her bare RIGHT arm to place her own open hand on Hermione's shoulder with fully traceable wrist and forearm, no crossing at all with Hermione's arm, no matching directions. Pansy's other arm is hidden under the surface. Only two hands appearing in panel, five fingers each including the partly occluded thumb, no hand resting on its own shoulder. Pansy's face recognizable as ref 1. Upper-body wide view at waterline so both shoulders, elbows, faces, and hand connections clearly readable. No lettering.

Chest-up both smiling, regaining breath in the water. Hermione at left asks first. Pansy on right uses her own LEFT hand, elbow shown, to brush wet black hair away from her own cheek, including silver H R P delicate chain on that correctly connected left wrist. No rings. Two exact balloons left high from Hermione, right lower from Pansy.
dialogue: Pansy: Gané. Es lo único que importa.

panels.scene: Hermione retaliates with ONE playful splash using her right forearm, open right hand connecting to visible wrist with natural curved four fingers and thumb. The splash flies toward Pansy's face mostly from below, leaves fingers readable. Pansy at right smiles with eyes closed. Hermione moves away starting a backstroke to left, her face above water, with one correct last speech balloon tail pointing to Hermione. Normal wet hair and water droplets.

pages.review: Cotejo completo con PDF638–639. Se conservaron título, seis globos íntegros y bromas. Viñeta 6: sigue cada mano hasta su propio antebrazo y hombro en dos alturas sin cruce; diamante único en el anular izquierdo de Hermione. Viñeta 7: dijes H R P en la izquierda de Pansy. Viñeta 8: mano abierta de Hermione con dedos definidos y gafas de Pansy conservadas. Corrección de mano pedida por el usuario.
